title: Door Series Price Book for Entry & Patio Door Contracts
content:
Entry & Patio Door Contracts are sold in six door series. Each series is either an entry door series or a patio door series, and each carries its own installed list price per door unit, its own smallest accepted contract price and its own largest number of door units per contract.

## Series figures

| Door series | Door type | Installed list price per standard-size door unit | Minimum signed contract price | Maximum door units per contract |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door | Entry | $2140.00 | $1995.00 | 6 |
| Ridgeline Portal 520 Smooth Fiberglass Entry Door | Entry | $2690.00 | $2495.00 | 6 |
| Ridgeline Glide 720 Vinyl Sliding Patio Door | Patio | $2980.00 | $2795.00 | 4 |
| Ridgeline Portal 640 Woodgrain Fiberglass Entry Door | Entry | $3460.00 | $2995.00 | 6 |
| Ridgeline Glide 840 Fiberglass Sliding Patio Door | Patio | $4280.00 | $3995.00 | 4 |
| Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door | Patio | $5860.00 | $5495.00 | 4 |

## What each figure means

- **Installed list price per standard-size door unit**: the installed list price of one door unit of the series at a standard size, in US dollars, before any discount program.
- **Minimum signed contract price**: the smallest signed contract price accepted for the series, in US dollars.
- **Maximum door units per contract**: the largest number of door units one contract in the series may carry.

A contract for an entry door series is a contract for entry doors; a contract for a patio door series is a contract for patio doors. The three entry door series are the Portal 310, Portal 520 and Portal 640; the three patio door series are the Glide 720, Glide 840 and Hinge 960.

## Reading the table (hypothetical examples)

- Hypothetical: four standard-size units of the Ridgeline Glide 840 Fiberglass Sliding Patio Door have an installed list price of four times $4280.00, that is $17120.00, before any discount program. Four is also the most units a Glide 840 contract may carry.
- Hypothetical: a fifth unit could not sit on a Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door contract, whose maximum is 4 units, while a Ridgeline Portal 640 Woodgrain Fiberglass Entry Door contract may carry up to 6.
- Hypothetical: a Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door contract signed at $1990.00 falls below that series' minimum of $1995.00; one signed at exactly $1995.00 reaches it.
